description: This file defines an enum `BinaryProtocolHolder` which implements the singleton pattern to manage instances of `BinaryProtocol`. It includes methods to create and retrieve the singleton instance, encapsulating the protocol handling logic within a singleton holder.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolHolder
classes.description: An enum singleton providing access to a `BinaryProtocol` instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current `BinaryProtocol` instance managed by the singleton.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new `BinaryProtocol` with the provided logger and stream, sets it in the singleton, and returns it.
